question: Which country has HOSTED the most Olympic Games?

post.premise: One country has hosted the Olympics eight times
post.bait: Paris just hosted its third. That is not even close.
post.sources_line: Olympics.com; International Olympic Committee; Wikipedia list of Olympic Games host cities

youtube.title: Which country has hosted the most Olympic Games? Olympics quiz 🏅
youtube.description:
France, Britain or the third one? Paris just hosted for the third time, London has done it three times too, and neither is anywhere near the record.
Count the Winter Games and one country runs away with it, with two more already booked. Guess before the pins drop.
One sports fact a day you can argue about — follow along.

threads.text: Which country has hosted the most Olympic Games — France, Britain or the third option? Paris 2024 made it three for France and London has three; the record holder has eight, with two more already on the calendar.

intent: A host-city map: the three countries everyone links with the Olympics, the real count once you add the Winter Games, the city pins dropping one by one, and the two already booked.

v04.text: United States. 8 Games so far: 4 summer and 4 winter, from St. Louis to Salt Lake City.

v05.text: France is second with 6 in total, including Paris. Britain has 3, all of them in London.

v06.text: Los Angeles hosts again in 2028, and Salt Lake City returns in 2034. That makes 10.

v07.text: Los Angeles then becomes only the third city ever to host 3 summer Games, after London and Paris.

v08.text: More than you thought. Follow us.

research.topic: Countries that have hosted the most Olympic Games: United States 8 (Summer 1904 St. Louis, 1932 & 1984 Los Angeles, 1996 Atlanta; Winter 1932 & 1980 Lake Placid, 1960 Squaw Valley, 2002 Salt Lake City), with LA 2028 and Salt Lake City 2034 awarded (→ 10); France 6 (1900, 1924, 2024 Paris; 1924 Chamonix, 1968 Grenoble, 1992 Albertville); UK 3 (London 1908, 1948, 2012)

myths.myth: France or Britain, the old Olympic nations, have hosted the most Games.
myths.reality: France has 6 (3 Summer, 3 Winter) and Britain 3; the United States has 8 (4 Summer, 4 Winter), with Los Angeles 2028 and Salt Lake City 2034 already awarded.

landscape.our_gap: Olympic Shorts are medal-table and record clips; nobody maps the host cities per country with the Winter Games counted, the pins dropping to a counter, and the two booked Games.
